An original young woman with long,
wavy brown hair wears a sheer brown
lace top with long sleeves and a ribbon
neck tie, layered over a fitted brown
jersey top. A black leather belt with an
ornate silver buckle cinches a dark lace
skirt. A silver pendant necklace and a
black leather bag strap complete the
look. Her expression is calm. Warm, soft
natural light and a blurred street
backdrop. Palette of chocolate, black,
and silver. Romantic and edgy, in the
style of a fall street-style editorial.
